blocks.heading: Questions we hear a lot
blocks.intro: If yours isn’t here, email hello@example.com.

items.question: How much does a new identity cost?

answer.p: It depends on how much there is to make. Most identities land between €6,000 and €14,000, type and a short guide included. After the first call we’ll give you a range in writing.

items.question: How long does a website take?

answer.p: Eight to twelve weeks for most sites, from the first workshop to launch. The words usually set the pace, so we start on them first.

items.question: Can we edit the website ourselves?

answer.p: Yes. Every site we build comes with an editor, and an hour with us to learn it. See [our websites](/services/websites) for more.

items.question: Do you work with clients abroad?

answer.p: About a third of our clients are outside Ireland. We meet on video and send proofs by post.
Small runs, on our **risograph**. Anything bigger goes to a printer we trust, and we check the proofs with you.
